stem: Angela would like to add another detail to support the ideas presented in her second paragraph (sentences 5–8). Which sentence **BEST** follows and supports the information in sentence 5?

options.label: A
options.text: Then, as a teenager, he developed a passion for playing arcade games.

options.label: B
options.text: Since he lived in a rural area of Japan, he was surrounded by nature.

options.label: C
options.text: It was obvious that Tajiri had many interests and was naturally curious.

options.label: D
options.text: In Japan, like in other countries in the world, there are millions of bugs.
